title: Eight games join Game Pass Essential on 15 Nov 2026 (Xbox's 25th anniversary)
beat: Xbox Wire's November 2026 wave 1 post (3 Nov) lists eight games joining Game Pass Essential on 15 Nov; 15 Nov is also the 25th anniversary of Xbox's North American launch.
first_report: Xbox Wire, 'Coming to Xbox Game Pass' November 2026 wave 1, 3 Nov 2026 (Megan Spurr, Senior Community Lead, Xbox Game Pass), read through WebFetch; Pure Xbox covered the eight on 8 Nov.

sources.who: Xbox Wire, Game Pass November 2026 wave 1 (3 Nov 2026)
sources.what: 'what's coming soon to the Game Pass Essential library on November 15': Banjo Kazooie, Banjo Tooie, Banjo Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts, Gears of War: Judgement (sic), Halo: Spartan Assault, Perfect Dark, Viva Piñata, Viva Piñata: TIP; Cloud and Console, Halo: Spartan Assault also PC
same eight, tier New to XGP Essential; says Xbox celebrates the 25th anniversary on Sunday 15 Nov

sources.who: Microsoft Source, 'Xbox Erupts on the Scene', 15 Nov 2001
sources.what: Xbox launched in North America on 15 Nov 2001

sources.who: Xbox Store product pages and catalog (art)

claims.claim: eight games join Game Pass Essential on 15 Nov 2026
platforms: console and cloud; Halo: Spartan Assault also PC
15 Nov 2026 is the 25th anniversary of Xbox's launch
claims.status: confirmed from the 2001 launch date (Microsoft Source) and Pure Xbox; Xbox Wire's wave post does not mention it, so the Reel says 'in the anniversary of Xbox' without crediting Xbox Wire for it
Xbox Wire writes Judgement and 'Viva Piñata: TIP'; the Reel uses the store titles Gears of War: Judgment and Viva Piñata: TIP

footage: stills: official Xbox Store art (hero art and screenshots, 1920x1080, no watermark). Footage tried: Steam (only Halo: Spartan Assault has a trailer, one game of eight, not used), Xbox Store catalog (no videos on the five pages), Rare and 343 trailers are on YouTube only.

drafts.instagram:
ثماني ألعاب تنضم إلى Game Pass Essential يوم الأحد 15 نوفمبر.

أعلنت إكس بوكس واير (Xbox Wire) أن فئة Game Pass Essential ستضم يوم 15 نوفمبر ثماني ألعاب هي Banjo-Kazooie وBanjo-Tooie وBanjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts وPerfect Dark وViva Piñata وViva Piñata: TIP وGears of War: Judgment وHalo: Spartan Assault.

وتتوفر الألعاب على أجهزة Xbox وعبر السحابة، وتتوفر Halo: Spartan Assault أيضًا على الحاسب. ويصادف يوم الأحد 15 نوفمبر مرور 25 عامًا على إطلاق Xbox في أمريكا الشمالية عام 2001.

الصور من متجر Xbox.

#ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #GamePass #Xbox
